Roster wins over species.ts on every shared field; species.ts (12 entries) supplies only catchRate/expYield/growthRate/dexText/learnset, matched by name. Abilities/eggGroups are owed for 47/47 (empty here, not invented). DexText/catchRate/expYield/growthRate present for 12/47; null elsewhere, not invented. Species count 47 to 49. Addendum 2026-10-28 (later): Gabu moved from dex 148 to dex 150 by the owner's canonical ruling (up two spots to 150); 148/149 are vacant and Dorowani stays 147. Count stays 49. Addendum 2026-10-28 (later): Goddgachuu (400) added per owner canon — a mystical Mochiichao at number 400, named by the owner with its type given by the owner (Mythic, owner-confirmed); base stats and dexText are owed (owner-set canon) and null here, not invented. Species count 49 to 50.

species.provenance: owner canon 2026-10-28: named by the owner in chat (~17:03 CT) — “Mochiichao 400 mystical mochiichao: Goddgachuu”, spelling confirmed by the owner (Goddgachuu, double-d). Type Mythic is OWNER-GIVEN by the owner's ruling the same day (~17:18 CT: “Mythic — land Goddgachuu at 400”) — owner-confirmed on this record, NOT derived (contrast Dorowani 147 / Gabu 150, whose types are signature-derived and still flagged as awaiting owner confirmation). Base stats + dexText owed (owner-set canon); null here, never invented. TYPE UPDATE — owner ruling 2026-10-28 (~18:06 CT: “Okay, he can be mythic and neon”): Neon added as second type; types are now Mythic + Neon, both owner-ruled (Mythic owner-given ~17:18 CT as recorded above; Neon ruled ~18:06 CT — the owner settling directly the ‘mythic dragon, whatever our universal equivalent of that is’ question: no new element invented, Neon is one of our existing fifteen). RARITY — owner ruling 2026-10-28 (~18:04 CT): Goddgachuu is the rarest Mochiichao, wired on the Pokémon Mythical pattern (see the rarity note in this record’s notes).
notes: Descriptor: a mystical Mochiichao (the owner's word, 2026-10-28). No art, cry, signature move, or dex text exists for this species in any repo source yet — this record lands the owner's canon note as data; nothing added, nothing inferred.

Numbering: 400 per owner ruling 2026-10-28; record 50 of 50 in this file. The number sits outside every existing range and was verified free in every scheme before landing: core ids ran 001–047 plus Dorowani 147 / Gabu 150, the global roster and the dex registry top out at 331 (Mythar, core 047), and the roster-lock register stands in the 050s. The three-scheme conflict (GAP-AUDIT Conflict 2; TBD register D1) is named here, not resolved by this record.

Rarity (owner ruling 2026-10-28, ~18:04 CT): Goddgachuu is the RAREST Mochiichao — wired on the Pokémon Mythical pattern at the owner’s direction (‘wire them up just like that’). Concretely: NO row in any spawn or encounter table — verified at this landing across src/data/core/encounters.json, encounters/dark-forest.spawn-tables.json (its depths table stays EMPTY by #163’s law), encounters/garden-complex.spawn-tables.json, encounters/region1-dojo-circuit.json, and ecology/region1.ecology.json (no residency) — and that absence IS the wiring: per #163 mythical habitat sealing, a sealed species has no row, not a rare row. Habitat SEALED — sealed record instanced at show/production/world-systems/sealing-records.json (mochiichao/habitat-sealing/v1; no area id, no coordinates, no table reference — nothing to leak). Obtainable only through an owner-authored set-piece if canon ever authors one (the #163/#52 authored set-piece route); none exists, so the sealed record’s accessFacts is empty by fact, and no table in the data can produce him. catchRate stays null — it belongs to the owner-set numbers family on this record, like base stats; the Pokémon pattern value for a battleable mythical (catch rate 3) is recorded in the research note, not landed. Roaming (#114) does not apply: roaming and mythical are separate axes and no roaming individual of this species is authored. Research: show/production/species-data-system/RESEARCH-NOTE-goddgachuu-rarity.md; design seat: DESIGN-BRIEF-goddgachuu.md.
